title: MOVING2024: Motor imagery / motor execution dataset from the MOVING study
description: A multi-modal dataset of 32-channel dry EEG recorded together with Virtual Glove hand-kinematic tracking from 11 healthy participants. Participants performed a rest, motor imagery, and motor execution sequence for three right-hand movements (open/close, wrist rotation, finger tapping), with eight repetitions each. This BIDS release was generated via MOABB from the published MOVING data and is intended for motor imagery and execution decoding research.
methods_description: EEG was acquired at 500 Hz with a Neuroelectrics Enobio 32 wireless dry-electrode system (10-20 montage, CMS/DRL reference). Each trial involved a rest, motor imagery, and motor execution triplet for three right-hand movements, with a 2 s fixation and 6 s action period, repeated eight times per subject (about 10 minutes). Hand kinematics were tracked with the Virtual Glove.
